static_traits.name: Wang Dawei
static_traits.social_status: Has a close friend providing support, but has not yet shared negative thoughts with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling before; no history of similar psychological problems before the breakup
static_traits.language_features: Slightly tense at the start but willing to cooperate; clear expression, fairly well-organized; able to self-Reflect and examine evidence; tone calm

basic_info.main_problem: I am troubled by a belief: that I am Single because I am a terrible person, which leads to self-blame and low self-worth.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative beliefs are affecting my mental health and my sense of well-being, and I want to deal with these problems.
growth_experiences: Experiencing a very difficult breakup several years ago, negative self-beliefs arising and gradually solidifying thereafter (such as 'I am a terrible person' 'destined not to be loved'), strongly activated when Seeing happy couples or Attending social activities; trying to distract through hobbies and self-care, but negative thinking persists, affecting self-esteem, interpersonal interactions, sleep and Work performance.
Family-of-origin background: Mother was a Teacher, may have been familiar with educational environments and related values while growing up (the case has not yet described specific effects further).

core_beliefs: I am inherently flawed, not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: Seeing happy couples or encountering people in pairs with partners at Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am still Single, it means I am not worthy of being loved, something is wrong with me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding or reducing attending Social gatherings; using hobbies and self-care to distract in order to reduce pain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am Single because I am a terrible person; I am destined not to be worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: When others do not proactively talk to me or respond warmly in Social situations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not proactively interact with me, it means I am not interesting, I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social situations; assuming others will reject oneself to reduce disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They ignore me, because I am not interesting, nobody would want to be with me

special_situations.event: Recalling that difficult breakup from a few years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a relationship ends in breakup, it proves I am inherently flawed, future relationships will fail too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Through self-blame and self-labeling 'explains' the breakup; avoids starting new intimate relationships; uses distraction to reduce pain
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That breakup shows I have a fundamental defect as a person, and I will fail in the future too

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved and accepted, to build a stable intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected again or relationship failure, being hurt by being judged as 'flawed'
defense_goal: Through Self-deprecation and preemptive negation, maintaining a sense of control to prevent disappointment
By Avoiding socializing, reducing the risk of Being rejected and getting hurt

object_relations.self_representation: flawed, a rejected person who is not good enough
object_relations.object_representation: Others/potential partners are judges or rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites examining evidence for 'why others do not proactively talk to me'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: tending to interpret others' lack of warmth as judgment of one's 'not good enough' (believing others think I am not interesting)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use expressions guessing others' thoughts (such as 'they think I am not interesting'), tone slightly hesitant with self-blame, avoiding specific factual details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the difficult breakup and related emotional experiences are mentioned
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Using the generalized personality label ('I am flawed') to Interpretation relationship failure, weakening specific emotional details to reduce Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Narrating causes in abstract analytical language (such as 'my personality is flawed'), downplaying emotional experiences with a steady tone, avoiding specific scenes and feelings.

manifestations: Repeatedly having the thought 'I am destined to be Loneliness/nobody will choose me' after the breakup
Feeling not belonging when Seeing happy couples and in social situations, excluded
outcomes: Decreased self-esteem and Low sense of self-worth
Work performance slightly affected, overall Decline in sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Expresses nervousness at the start, finds it hard to open up easily
Frequently engaging in self-blame with 'I am not good enough/I am flawed'
Cautious in socializing and avoids direct contact with others

positive_force: Has one supportive friend (although not yet sharing negative thoughts for now)
Continuously trying to cope through hobbies and self-care (shows a self-help tendency)
Actively seeks psychological counseling; has motivation to change
negative_force: Intense self-blame and low sense of self-worth
Social avoidance, easily personalizing others' behaviors
All-or-nothing thinking and self-labeling; prone to generalizing one breakup into total failure
Sleep affected and Decline in work performance, further Reinforcing Negative self-evaluation

antecedent: Thinking about being in a Single state
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief of 'I am a terrible person/not worthy of being loved' formed after the difficult breakup, worrying about Being rejected and being judged
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible judgment and rejection, to reduce Anxiety and shame in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem, Declining sleep quality, Work performance slightly affected, further reducing opportunities to build intimate relationships
